verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Teams features share some conversation state across a team: read statuses are shared and teammates can see when others are replying, which helps avoid collisions. However, no evidence shows true shared inboxes, shared accounts, or team channels where everyone works the same mailbox, and the team-comments material is phrased as generic advice about collaboration tools rather than a clear description of a Superhuman feature. missing for 10: documented shared inbox or shared-account support, team channels with a common conversation view, assignment or ownership of threads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state

citations.quote: Read statuses are now shared across your team, so anybody can follow up with full context.
See when your team is replying, so you can avoid double work and embarrassing collisions.
